description.value:
Big Ball Spiraling Sphere. A Rasengan grown to an unwieldy boulder of compressed chakra (often assisted by a shadow clone holding the original in place while you expand it).

Make a melee spell attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 9d10 force damage and is pushed 20 feet directly away from you (knocked prone if it strikes a wall or another creature). The target's space, and the squares between you and the target's new position, become difficult terrain for 1 round.

You may target a 5-foot square instead of a single creature to attempt to crater terrain; on a successful spell attack against the surface's hardness, you create a difficult-terrain crater 10 feet wide.

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d10.

system.requirements: both hands free, OR at least one Kage Bunshin active
